sources.title: Models overview - Claude Platform Docs
sources.snippet: Models overview Claude is a family of state-of-the-art large language models developed by Anthropic. Compare the current lineup, find the model ID for every platform, and open each model's page for its full specs and resources.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5 \ Anthropic
sources.snippet: Claude Opus 5 is a strong agentic coding model built for long-running, multi-step work. It deeply understands your codebase, holds the thread across complex tasks, and pins down requirements for feature development and bug-fixing more effectively than Opus 4.8.

sources.title: LiveBench
sources.snippet: Contamination-free LLM benchmark A challenging, contamination-free LLM benchmark. 23 objective tasks across 7 categories, refreshed every six months. Pick a release, compare scores down to the subtask, and see what each model costs to run.
